title: Story index v2 (ROOT/data/index.json; DESIGN_tierA section 7.2, frozen at R0)
description: Strictly additive to story-index/1. One writer: scripts/export_story_data.py manifest (merges R1 entries, R6 picker fields, R7 gates); nobody hand-edits it. 'default' stays the {galaxy, ray} object (engine.js lineUrl and resolveStory read index.default.galaxy); the story id goes in the new key default_story. picker 'off' (default) means the page behaves byte-identically to v2 (H0): the v2 'Try another beam' dialog, engine.resolveStory and story_vtt must see the same entries they see today, so v3 story entries must not change what /1 consumers resolve (they are reachable only by ?story=<id>, and listed only when picker is 'cases' and gates.all is true). film_beams stays until a grep shows no consumer in scripts/, tests/ and render.html. JSON Schema subset of js/engine.js schemaErrors.

default_story.description: id of the default story; 'full' (the hand-tuned hero tour)

binfile.description: TNGS binary line; engine.js lineUrl/fetchBin load it as bytes, not JSON

id.description: 'full' for the hero; clean, multiphase, damped, empty, hot for Tier A

line.description: Tier A: the stored TNGS line (data/-relative, v3/lines/<g>_<ray>.bin); without it the page looks in the explorer library, which lacks most Tier A rays (fix1 H1)

beats.description: hero: beats.json (unchanged name); Tier A: beats.<id>.json

shots.description: hero: shots.json (unchanged name); Tier A: shots.<id>.json

title.description: card title, <= 5 words, no digits, no trailing full stop

blurb.description: card blurb, <= 12 words, no digits, no trailing full stop
